key_impacts: Bridges were ripped away; homes obliterated along the Acelhuate River
No fatalities reported in Fenadesal Sur
evidence_snippets: November’s storm struck the town of Fenadesal Sur, dumping 14 inches of rain in just four hours.
It transformed the Acelhuate River into a torrent that ripped away bridges and obliterated homes.
30 houses destroyed and more than 100 damaged—the 300 people whose homes were at risk made it to safety.
